notes: Only 1 retransmission: below the 3-retransmission noise floor, so the finding is expected to be the informational 'tcp_loss_minor', not 'tcp_loss'.
description: Upload captured on the sending client: one segment is lost after the capture point, the server sends three duplicate ACKs and the client fast-retransmits within 1 ms. Expected: fast retransmission flagged, loss located beyond the capture point.
